message.content:
Java is a high‑level, class‑based, object‑oriented programming language designed to have as few implementation dependencies as possible. It was originally developed by James Gosling at Sun Microsystems (now owned by Oracle) and released in 1995. Here’s what makes Java notable:

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Platform independence** | “Write once, run anywhere” – compiled bytecode runs on any device equipped with a Java Virtual Machine (JVM). |
| **Object‑Oriented** | Everything revolves around objects; supports encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction. |
| **Strongly typed & safe** | Compile‑time type checking reduces runtime errors; automatic memory management via garbage collection protects against many bugs. |
| **Rich Standard Library** | Includes utilities for collections, networking, I/O, concurrency, GUI (Swing/JavaFX), database connectivity ( JDBC ), etc. |
| **Multithreading support** | Built‑in thread classes and synchronization primitives make concurrent programming easier. |
| **Performance** | Just‑In‑Time (JIT) compilation optimizes code during execution; modern JVMs produce near native performance. |

Typical use cases include enterprise back‑end services, Android mobile apps, web servers, scientific computing, embedded systems, and more. Java remains one of the most widely used languages worldwide due to its robustness, portability, and extensive ecosystem.
